comments.body:
Wanted to bring attention to EIP-7742: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8735

The CL changes are here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3800

I am not sure if I will be able to make this call. If I can, I'll give a short overview of the EIP. If not, I'll ask client teams to take a look. 

It's a small change and I would suggest Pectra inclusion. There's some uncertainty around PeerDAS and blob count increase timelines IMO and if we end up not touching that in Pectra then I think delaying this particular EIP until the next hard fork would be fine.

About the EIP-7212 agenda, I want to repost my message from the Discord ACD channel which I think is relevant.

> Hello! I am Ulaş, RIP editor and co-author of RIP-7212. Before the next ACDE this week, I wanted to prepare a short brief (in my view, please correct me if I am wrong) to help with the decision of including the proposal in the Pectra hard fork. It includes history, current implementations summary, some debates, and my final view.
> 
> https://hackmd.io/@ulerdogan/B1QikMxdC

We did an EIP7702 whiteboarding session at ETHCC, and want to get additional feedback on some changes to the spec.
Writeup: https://hackmd.io/@S9AwbucvTS6GYodLz-G1SQ/S102UtTwA

The proposal, reduces work required to manage DOS, enables new use-cases and supports ephemeral SCAs.
We wrote a response to the above `CODERESET` proposal and a reflection on the current 7702 spec’s state: https://hackmd.io/@otim/SJ8FGKBd0

> We wrote a response to the above `CODERESET` proposal and a reflection on the current 7702 spec’s state: https://hackmd.io/@otim/SJ8FGKBd0

Thanks. Please see my comments in your md.
Would be good to confirm that we're going to add logs to EIP-7002 and EIP-7251 system contracts (via) https://github.com/lightclient/sys-asm/pull/17
Added everything above to the agenda 🫡 !

It would be good to link the discussion on EOF that happened in a response to Marius [EOF concerns](https://mariusvanderwijden.github.io/blog/2024/07/12/EOF/) post:  https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/1261382042944274524
Closing this issue in favor of https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1104
